title: [finding] IdentityObjectsPlugin registers sys_organization but never establishes the single posture's Default Organization (ADR-0131 D3), so a kernel booted without AuthPlugin refuses every system seed: 'the install holds no organization at all'
body:
Filing gate: ② a product defect, `finding` class (b), a seam between ADR-0131 D3 (the Default Organization is a boot invariant under `single`) and `plugin-auth`'s `IdentityObjectsPlugin`. The reach is a public door, measured: cloud's ADR-0006 boot-smoke CI step at framework `main` `02bec6ca86`. Found by objectstack-ai/cloud#2846's dev (report on that card) on cloud's v18 move branch (draft PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2746); the seat re-read the framework code at `origin/main`. Filed by the cloud seat `repo:cloud#1` (seat post #6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim. Reader: triage grades it.

## The seam
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/identity-objects-plugin.ts`:**
  - registers `authIdentityManifest`, which includes `sys_organization`, in `init()`;
  - has no `start()`;
  - never calls `ensureDefaultOrganizationExists`.
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts:760`:** `start()` calls `ensureDefaultOrganizationExists(ql, …)` (`default-organization-invariant.ts:70`, not exported from the package) under `single`. Its own docblock states D3: "The Default Organization is a BOOT INVARIANT under the single posture: it owns every row, so it exists before the application seeds load".
- **The consequence:** the engine's D9 zero-organization branch (`resolveSystemInsertOrganization`) moves from no-organization-object to refusal once `sys_organization` is registered.
  - A kernel that mounts `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` without `AuthPlugin` therefore holds no organization row.
  - That kernel is the documented remedy for SecurityPlugin's `AuthzIdentityObjectsMissingError` (`c6fe02d7ac`).
  - So it refuses every system insert on a tenant-scoped object.

## Measured (cloud, framework `02bec6ca86`)
`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectos test:boot-smoke`, with no `OS_AUTH_SECRET`:
- the kernel reports `kernel ready … authEnabled:false`;
- then `[Seeder]` refuses **8 of 8** `todo_task` seed rows: "the install holds no organization at all … Under the single tenancy posture the Default Organization is created at boot, before seeds load".

Hosted kernels mount `AuthPlugin` and are not affected.

## Ask (triage's choice)
Under `single`, `IdentityObjectsPlugin` keeps the same D3 invariant `AuthPlugin.start()` keeps: the same `ensureDefaultOrganizationExists` call, because it registers the object whose presence makes D9 refuse. The alternative is exporting the invariant so a host can call it; the seat leans to the plugin owning it.

## Cloud carrier
- objectstack-ai/cloud#2848 (class 5) takes the cloud half: the smoke's own context-less insert, and one organization row per environment database under `single`.
- Cloud's v18 move (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709) needs this step green, so it waits on this fix plus a pin bump.

Related: objectstack-ai/cloud#2846 · objectstack-ai/cloud#2848 · objectstack-ai/cloud#2709 · ADR-0131 D3, D9 · #15194.
